# Test fixtures

Cropped around the face and downscaled to ~360 px for the test suite.

| File | Subject | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `astronaut.jpg` | Eileen Collins (NASA) | scikit-image sample data (`skimage/data/astronaut.png`, v0.22.0) | Public domain (NASA) |
| `obama.jpg`, `obama2.jpg` | Barack Obama (two different photos) | `ageitgey/face_recognition` examples | Public domain (official US government photos) |
| `biden.jpg` | Joe Biden | `ageitgey/face_recognition` examples | Public domain (official US government photo) |

Used only to test detection, recognition and spoof rejection; no real voter data is stored in the repo.
